records.issue_text: app/models/blocked_email.rb:17 — Statistics updates occur within the User#save transaction and roll back when validation rejects a blocked email, preventing match_count and last_match_at from persisting.
records.rationale: The finding identifies a real issue. Looking at the diff, `BlockedEmail.should_block?` is called from `EmailValidator#validate_each` (line 13 of email_validator.rb), which runs during User model validation.
